children.value: > Fact From Story | Dating app Bumble announced a doozy this week: It’s replacing founder CEO Whitney Wolfe Herd with Slack CEO Lidiane Jones.
> > Fact From Story | Jones only started as CEO at Slack last year, stepping in for another founder CEO, Stewart Butterfield.
> > > Fact From Story | Slack CEO Lidiane Jones is becoming CEO of Bumble.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | A person can only be the CEO of one company at a time.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | Replacing someone means that the person replaced is no longer in the role.
> Commonsense Knowledge | When a company replaces its CEO, it loses its CEO.
